title_lines: 供给冲击传导明显偏弱
title_highlights: 供给冲击传导明显偏弱

subtitles.en: It was interesting that Fedger was said that the FOMC members didn't think the economy was running too hot Last month's nominal GDP was one of the hottest that we've seen in decades excluding the post-pandemic
subtitles.zh: 有趣的是，美联储表示FOMC成员认为经济并未过热。上月名义GDP是几十年来最热的之一，除了疫情后
en_highlights: didn't think the economy was running too hot

subtitles.en: sort of I guess unusualness of that balance there if you take a look at that Do you think that it squares with underlying inflation around 2% or do you think the economy is running too hot?
subtitles.zh: 那种不寻常的平衡，如果你看看的话。你认为这与2%左右的基础通胀相符吗，还是你认为经济过热了？

subtitles.en: I do agree with the chairman and here's the pandemic inflation comparison is a very good one because the Propagation story is the same here, right? There is a bold demand and supply shock
subtitles.zh: 我同意主席的观点，这里与疫情通胀的比较很好，因为传导机制相同，对吧？存在强劲的需求和供给冲击

subtitles.en: There was none of the case in 2021-2022 and now we might be in a similar situation But the amplification is not there. So that's why the chairman said they don't think the economy is running too hot
subtitles.zh: 2021-2022年没有这种情况，现在我们可能处于类似情况，但没有放大效应。所以主席说他们认为经济并未过热

subtitles.en: It was running too hot in 2021 and 2022 because the problem then was a bottleneck problem, right?
subtitles.zh: 2021和2022年经济过热是因为当时的问题是瓶颈问题，对吧？

subtitles.en: You you have a high demand It's really the constraint supply in 2021-2022. So the amplification was huge
subtitles.zh: 你有高需求，2021-2022年真正是供给约束。所以放大效应巨大

subtitles.en: Very high inflation and you know an economy that you know running up today We don't have the same amplification. So we have inflation, but it's not that high
subtitles.zh: 非常高的通胀，经济过热。今天我们没有同样的放大效应。所以有通胀，但没那么高

subtitles.en: We have a point three percent extra inflation over the last seven quarters that can be linked to both tariffs and the energy shock
subtitles.zh: 过去七个季度我们有0.3个百分点的额外通胀，这与关税和能源冲击有关

subtitles.en: So they are they are also supply shocks, but not like supply constraints to do to the extent that happened during the pandemic inflation
subtitles.zh: 所以它们也是供给冲击，但不像疫情通胀期间那样是供给约束

clip_research.source_claim: Today's inflation lacks the amplification seen in 2021-2022; only about 0.3% extra inflation over the last seven quarters can be linked to tariffs and the energy shock, so the economy is not running too hot.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public FOMC materials describe inflation moderating and the labor market easing, with the Fed cutting rates in late 2024; some public commentary in 2026 argues the economy is running hot.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The speaker's claim that the economy is not running too hot contrasts with some public commentary asserting the US economy is running hot, though the FOMC baseline is broadly consistent with moderation.

evidence.fact: Speaker says amplification is not there now, unlike 2021-2022, and only 0.3% extra inflation over seven quarters is linked to tariffs and the energy shock.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
